facts.business: Hindustan Unilever Limited is a leading Indian consumer goods company operating in Home Care, Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care, and Foods segments.
key_risks: Macro environment expected to remain volatile amid evolving geopolitical developments
facts.related_party_note: The Company has an established and well-governed framework for the approval and monitoring of Related Party Transactions (RPTs). In accordance with the Act and the Listing Regulations, the Board has adopted a comprehensive Policy on Materiality of Related Party Transactions.
